steps.text: Power bus three is dead. Without it, the heater goes next.
I'm logging everything. Let's fix it step by step.

config.title: Reroute the power
config.prompt: Put the repair steps in the right order.
config.hint: Isolate the broken part before you move anything else.
config.learn: Engineers isolate a damaged circuit first so the fault cannot spread to the rest of the ship.

steps.text: Power is back. Now the air. The gauge is way off.

config.title: Tune the oxygen pressure
config.prompt: Turn the dial until the cabin pressure reads normal.
config.hint: Normal air pressure at sea level is a little above 100.
config.learn: Cabin air is kept near sea-level pressure, about 101 kilopascals, so people can breathe easily.

steps.text: Air is stable. Last step: restart the main systems safely.

config.title: Restart the systems
config.prompt: Restart everything in the safe order.
config.hint: Test before you start. Never skip the self-test.
config.learn: Spacecraft restarts follow checklists, so each system is checked before the next one starts.

steps.text: The ship is back. Everybody okay?
Everybody's fine. The heater is warm, and we're finishing this mission.
Log entry: the ship is healthy, and so is the crew.
